create_timings_instance: create a Timings instance to track elapsed time between events by name
use_timings_time: use the time method to record elapsed time for a named event since last call
use_timings_track: use the track context manager to automatically time a block of code by name
get_timings_stats: get the mean and standard deviation for a named timing event using the get method
print_timings_summary: print a formatted summary of all timing events sorted by mean duration with percentages
